notes.title: Plateman - a steampunk 2D platformer & adventure game - now has a Steam page!
notes.content:
[h1][b]We are LemonBow Studio. Plateman is a steampunk 2D platformer & adventure game, and also is the first game we developed. Now it is on Steam now![/b][/h1]

This is a steampunk 2D platformer & adventure game where you could experience innovative platform design and rich combat elements.

Integrating the myths and legends of Shaman of Buryats into the Steampunk game setting, we hope players can enjoy not only the amazing platform design but also the cultural clash and civilization transition while the plot is advancing.

The demo will be available soon. If you want to get all the updates about Plateman, follow and wishlist the game!
You can discuss with us and give us feedback on Steam's forum or get on Platemen’s QQ group: 699912656.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146970/_/
